metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: QEFRAY crystallizes in the orthorhombic crystal system with space group I m m m. Reported CIF formula moiety: C128 H262 Gd32 N24 O186,70(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Gd1 (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd2 (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd3 (Gd) has 10 O neighbors; Gd4 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd5 (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd6 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd7 (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd1A (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd2A (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd3A (Gd) has 10 O neighbors; Gd4A (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd5A (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd6A (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd7A (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd1B (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd2B (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd3B (Gd) has 10 O neighbors; Gd4B (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd5B (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd6B (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd7B (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd1C (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd2C (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd3C (Gd) has 10 O neighbors; Gd4C (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd5C (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd6C (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd7C (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd5H (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd5I (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd5J (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd5K (Gd) has 8 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 76 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.720-5.819 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 81.20-172.78°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Gd32(EDTA)12(OAc)2(C2O4)(CO3)2(μ3-OH)36(μ5-OH)4(H2O)36]·approximately 70H2O. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 2 OAc (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 36 μ3-OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 4 μ5-OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 36 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.

candidate_structural_motifs.method: agglomerative weighted modularity; edge weight = shared oxygen count
candidate_structural_motifs.interpretation_limit: Algorithmic graph partition, not author-defined units or an assembly pathway. Check symmetry, disorder, bond completeness and article figures before interpreting motifs.
